name: button
title: Button
summary: Runs an action or submits a form.
use_when: Triggering an action: save, create, send
avoid_when: Navigating to another page: use a link
More than one primary button in a view: demote the rest to secondary or ghost

props.variant: default | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link
props.loading: boolean, keeps the width and blocks clicks
props.asChild: boolean, render as the child element (for links)

copy.label: Starts with a verb that names the result: Create invoice, not Submit. At most 3 words.
